verdict.rationale: Homebrew's first-party tap system is exactly this extension mechanism. `brew tap` adds third-party repositories supplying formulae, casks and external commands, from GitHub or any Git URL. It also supports fully qualified per-tap selection, per-item trust, untapping, tap-provided bottles, and tap manpage and completion symlinks. A community member confirms running their own tap, though they found hosting one harder because it needs a Git server rather than a static CDN. Missing for 10: documentation on how external-command plugins are authored, and evidence of lower-friction tap hosting.
